title: fix(fields): a formula whose returnType is currency renders as money (objectui#12111)
body:
Fixes #12111
Clause-②: no

## What changes

A formula declared `returnType: 'currency'` now renders as money on both formula faces. Each face hands the formula's own definition to the currency field's own face:

- **Cell**: `FormulaCellRenderer` gains a `currency` branch that returns `CurrencyCellRenderer` with the formula's `field`.
- **Form / detail**: `FormulaField` gains a `currency` branch that renders `CurrencyField` read-only with the formula's `field`. Before that, it applies the same reading the currency cell applies: blank is empty, and a value that is not a number keeps its text.

No new money formatter is added. Both currency faces read the currency through `resolveFieldCurrency(field, tenantCurrency)` and format it through `formatCurrency`.

Every other `returnType` takes the same path as before. That covers `number`, `text`, `boolean`, `date`, and a formula with no `returnType`.

## Measured mechanism (dispatch A1)

`resolveFieldCurrency` lives in `@object-ui/i18n` `currency.ts`, and `@object-ui/fields` re-exports it. It reads the field definition in this order:

1. `field.currency`
2. `field.currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, but only when `currencyMode === 'fixed'`
3. `field.defaultCurrency`
4. the tenant default from `useLocalization().currency`

Both `CurrencyCellRenderer` and `CurrencyField` call it with the whole `field`. So a formula's `currencyConfig` arrives the same way a currency field's does. An absent `currencyConfig`, or a `dynamic` one, falls through to the tenant default. That matches the spec's "no `currencyConfig`: dynamic, the tenant default currency".

The installed spec is `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2`. Its `FieldSchema.returnType` is `z.enum(["number", "text", "boolean", "date", "currency"])`, and its `currencyConfig` description says it covers "a formula field whose returnType is currency".

## Premise re-check on `origin/main` `2ec9e2a1a4`

- The core premise holds: neither formula face had a `currency` branch.
- One detail of the card's reading is stale. The card and the spec seat's note `6103175421` say an unknown `returnType` was drawn with the monospace text face. Since objectui#12357, both faces draw it through the text face instead (`TextCellRenderer` in the cell). So before this PR, a `currency` formula read as plain text, `3456`, not as monospace.

## Pins

The new test file is `packages/fields/src/__tests__/formulaFaces.currency-12111.test.tsx`. Each case runs on both faces.

- (a) A fixed CNY `currencyConfig` reads `CN¥3,456.00` under a USD tenant, which is the text a CNY currency field reads.
- (b) With no `currencyConfig`, the amount reads `$3,456.00` under a USD tenant and `€3,456.00` under a EUR tenant, which is the text a currency field with no config reads. A `dynamic` config naming JPY reads the tenant's `$`.
- (c) The form face equals `CurrencyField`'s read-only face, and the cell face equals `CurrencyCellRenderer`, row by row. The cell and the form read the same text.
- (d) CONTROL: `returnType: 'number'` still reads `3,456`, with no symbol, even when a `currencyConfig` is present.
- A numeric string is read as the amount. Whitespace shows the shared empty affordance, not a made-up `0`.

**Ablation (cell).** I replaced the cell's `currency` branch with a marker comment, using objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an anchor that must match. The anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `6a834188abe7` to `cda2758d53b5`. The result was `Tests 6 failed | 7 passed (13)`, exit 1. All six failures are cell rows; the form rows and the CONTROL stayed green. I restored the file with `git checkout HEAD --`, and its `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob `6a834188abe758a969b8cb2006669d5b0f4e9b48`. After the restore, `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build is involved, because the test imports `../index` source directly.

## Gates (head `5830fd6d53`, except where noted)

- Closure build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` exit 0. That runs `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`. `--listFilesOnly` lists the new test file once.
- Targeted vitest: 4 files, 123 tests passed. They are the new pin, `formulaFaces.returnType-11748`, `formulaFaces.textFace-12357` and `currencyMode.faces-10422`.
- The whole `packages/fields/` directory, all 266 test files, every chunk exit 0. Run as a single invocation, it was killed by a 9-minute cap, so I split it into 7 chunks, each run under the lock with `--maxWorkers=1`. Two of the chunks (98 files) ran at `54252d8602`. The only difference from head is the new test file's escape spelling, which I re-ran at head.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 3 changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors. `--format json` reports 3 files. All warnings are pre-existing (`react-refresh/only-export-components`, `no-explicit-any` on the existing `FormulaField` signature), and none is on a changed line. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this change cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- These gates each exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, and `check:new-line-citations` (0 new).

## Acceptance notes

- `CurrencyField`'s read-only face does not accept a `className`. So a `currency` formula on the form face drops an author `className`, as a currency field's read-only face does. The other formula branches still apply it.
- Out of this card, as ruled: the designer stamp (`celAuthoring.ts` and `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, calling `inferFormulaReturn`). This PR does not address it.
- Typing gap, not filed: `FormulaFieldMetadata` in `@object-ui/types` declares `returnType` but not `currencyConfig`. The renderers receive the key at runtime from object metadata, and this PR does not need the declaration. Its JSDoc also still says text is drawn "in monospace", which stopped being true with objectui#12357. Both sit outside this card's file surface.
